column1: # Which Juice Shop challenge an agent's lead or evidence names (tools/juiceshop_score.py, D-060).
# One row per indicator: the challenge key, its name in Juice Shop 20.2.0 (checked against the
# catalogue, so a renamed or removed challenge fails loudly), a confidence, a Python regular
# expression (case-insensitive) and why the indicator points at that challenge. Columns are
# separated by one tab. A challenge may have several rows.
#   firm       the text names something only this challenge is about: its file, its path, its
#   uncertain  the text names a class of issue that fits this challenge and others, or that the
#              agent could only suspect with read-only requests (e.g. "SQL injection in the
#              search"). Listed for review, never counted unless a reviewer confirms it.
# A firm match is listed as uncertain when any sentence of the same lead or evidence entry that
# matches has a negation ("no", "not", "without", ...): "no stack trace was shown" names the stack
# trace and says it is absent.
# Challenges without a row cannot be identified from text by this table (most need a write, a
# signed-in user, or an answer only a person would recognise); they still count when solved.
# Matching runs over the run's leads (title, detail, URL) and evidence (summary, URI) only.
